segments.title: Advisory Committee Review Process Overview
segments.takeaway: Staff presented the ongoing review of advisory committees, outlining the consultation process and initial feedback on mandates and effectiveness.

segments.title: Incorporating Sponsorship into Committee Mandate
segments.takeaway: The committee proposed officially adding its sponsorship program to its mandate, emphasizing its unique value for community organizations.

segments.title: Challenges with Timely Referrals
segments.takeaway: Committee members expressed frustration that agenda items often arrive too late or with insufficient notice for effective advisory input.

segments.title: Exploring Earlier Referral Models
segments.takeaway: Staff and committee discussed adopting a model, like the Municipal Planning Commission, to ensure advisory committees receive information earlier in the decision-making process.

segments.title: Improving Referral Relevance and Member Engagement
segments.takeaway: The committee requested more focused referrals relevant to their mandate, noting that a lack of meaningful work contributes to member disengagement.

segments.title: Motion on Advisory Committee Review Feedback
segments.takeaway: The committee passed a motion to provide further direction and feedback to staff regarding the ongoing review of advisory committees.

segments.title: New Detailed Budget Submission Requirements
segments.takeaway: Staff informed the committee about new requirements for detailed, categorized budget submissions for 2027, replacing previous lump-sum allocations.

segments.title: Discussing 2027 Budget Allocations
segments.takeaway: The committee discussed and planned specific allocations for its 2027 budget, including funds for partnerships, education, and membership development.
